name: Magnet Genius
author: Best WP Developer

sections.description:
Magnet Genius is a powerful WordPress plugin designed to help you grow your email list by offering downloadable content (magnet genius) in exchange for visitors’ contact information.

Key Features:

  • Easy Setup: Create unlimited magnet genius forms with a simple interface
  • Flexible Deployment: Display your magnet genius using shortcodes or automatic popups
  • Customizable Forms: Customize button text, form title, and more
  • Targeted Display: Show your magnet genius forms on specific pages or across your entire site
  • Subscriber Management: Track and manage your subscribers from a convenient dashboard
  • Download Protection: Securely deliver your files only to confirmed subscribers
  • Responsive Design: Works flawlessly on all devices and screen sizes

💬 New Features:

  • 📲 WhatsApp Welcome Messaging
    Instantly send a welcome message to the user’s WhatsApp number when they submit the form.

  • 🔁 Follow-up Message Scheduling
    Add multiple timed follow-up messages using a repeater field. Set the delay using minutes, hours, days, months, or even years — and define custom text for each message.

  • ⚠️ Visual Warnings with Image Popups
    Enhance alert messages with clickable warning labels (e.g., ⚠️Warning⚠️) that display context-specific images from your plugin’s assets folder. No extra library needed.

  • 🧩 Admin-Friendly Interface
    Easy-to-use settings and message list UI built with native WordPress styling — no coding required.

  • 🔐 Secure & Optimized
    Sanitizes and validates all user inputs, uses secure API requests, and adheres to WordPress development standards.

Perfect For:

  • Ebooks and PDF guides
  • Checklists and worksheets
  • Templates and resources
  • Free courses and tutorials
  • Exclusive content upgrades

How It Works:

  1. Create a new magnet genius form with your downloadable file
  2. Configure display settings and customize the form
  3. Add the shortcode to your content or enable popup mode
  4. Collect subscriber information and automatically deliver your content

Privacy Considerations:

This plugin collects user email addresses and names. Please ensure your privacy policy addresses this data collection.

External Services

This plugin connects to the Mailchimp API to add subscribers to your selected audience list. This is required to send subscription data from your WordPress site to your Mailchimp account.

It sends the subscriber’s email address, first name, last name (if provided), and other optional fields to Mailchimp when a user submits the subscription form.

The service is provided by Mailchimp (Intuit Inc.):
– Terms of Service: https://mailchimp.com/legal/terms/
– Privacy Policy: https://mailchimp.com/legal/privacy/

Additional Information

Privacy

This plugin collects and stores user email addresses and names when they submit a magnet genius form. This information is stored in your WordPress database and is not shared with any third parties unless you explicitly use an integration that does so.

Credits

Magnet Genius plugin was developed to help WordPress site owners grow their email lists effectively through strategic content upgrades and lead generation campaigns.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the magnet-genius folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
  3. Go to ‘Magnet Genius’ in your admin menu to create your first magnet genius
sections.faq:
How do I add a magnet genius form to my posts or pages?

After creating your magnet genius form, you’ll get a shortcode like [magnet-genius id="1"]. Simply paste this shortcode wherever you want the form to appear.

Can I customize the design of the forms?

Yes! The forms use your theme’s styling by default, but you can also customize them with custom CSS.

What file types can I use as magnet genius?

You can use any file type as your magnet genius: PDFs, ZIP files, images, videos, audio files, etc.

Can I track who downloads my magnet genius?

Yes, the plugin maintains a database of all subscribers and tracks when they download your content.

Can I export my subscribers list?

Yes, you can export your subscribers list from the Subscribers page in the admin panel.

Is this plugin compatible with popular email marketing services?

While the plugin collects emails independently, we’re planning to add integration with popular email marketing services in future updates.
